header: SIMULATION on a logical trace: no residency/transfer semantics; Granite fully fits GPU memory.

assumptions.initial_state: cold per phase, layer and sequence; no prefill warming of decode
assumptions.hit_accounting: all eight lookups use token-entry slots; then update in array order
assumptions.LFU: resident counts start at 1 on admission, reset on eviction; LRU breaks ties
assumptions.overlap: intersection size / 8, adjacent positions only, within sequence and phase
assumptions.entropy: Shannon bits of unweighted expert selection counts (maximum 5 bits)
assumptions.overall: request-weighted hit rate; weights do not affect hit counting
